mutations.name: archived copy ignored
mutations.find: return archived ? { task: archived, archived: true } : undefined;
kills: locateTask falls back to the archived copy with archived true

mutations.name: live task flagged archived
mutations.find: if (live) return { task: live, archived: false };
mutations.replace: if (live) return { task: live, archived: true };
kills: locateTask returns a live task with archived false

mutations.name: homes skip archived files
kills: homesOf lists every initiative holding the id live or archived
